points.case_title: Information is provided about what kind of personal information is collected
points.quote_text: 3. Data We Collect
points.title: Information is provided about what kind of information they collect

points.case_title: This service is a subsidiary of Company X
points.quote_text: Further, we are part of the Match Group family of businesses.
points.title: This service is a subsidiary of Company X

points.case_title: First-party cookies are used
points.quote_text: First-party cookies are placed on your device directly by us.
points.title: First-party cookies are used

points.case_title: Third-party cookies are used for statistics
points.quote_text: We use Google Analytics, which is a Google service that uses cookies and other data collection technologies to collect information about your use of the website and services in order to report website trends.
points.title: Google Analytics is used for statistics

points.case_title: Your profile is combined across various products
points.quote_text: To accomplish these purposes, we also may link information from cookies with other personal information we hold about you.
points.title: Your profile is combined across various products

points.case_title: A list of all cookies used by the service is provided
points.quote_text:
When you use our services, some or all of the following types of cookies may be set on your device.

| | | | --- | --- | | Cookie type | Description | | Essential cookies |
points.title: A list of all cookies set by the website is provided

points.case_title: Third-party cookies are used for statistics
points.quote_text: | Analytics cookies | These cookies help us understand how our services are being used and help us customize and improve our services for you.
points.title: Third-party cookies are used for statistics

points.case_title: Third-party cookies are used for advertising
points.quote_text: | Advertising & marketing cookies | These cookies are used to determine how effective our marketing campaigns are and make the ads you see more relevant to you.
points.title: Third-party cookies are used for advertising

points.case_title: You are being tracked via social media cookies/pixels
points.quote_text: | Social networking cookies | These cookies are used to enable you to share pages and content that you find interesting on our services through third-party social networking and other websites or services. These cookies may also be used for advertising purposes.
points.title: You are being tracked via social media cookies/pixels

points.case_title: Blocking first-party cookies may limit your ability to use the service
points.quote_text: Please note that changes you make to your cookie preferences may make using our services a less satisfying experience as they may not be as personalized to you. In some cases, you may even find yourself unable to use all or part of our services.
points.title: Blocking first party cookies may limit your ability to use the service

points.case_title: Third-party cookies are employed, but with opt out instructions
points.quote_text:
You can set and adjust your cookies preferences at any time, by using the tool available on our website, and by heading to your account settings in your app and adjusting your app cookie preferences there.

Browser and devices controls

Some web browsers provide settings that allow you to control or reject cookies or to alert you when a cookie is placed on your computer. The procedure for managing cookies is slightly different for each internet browser.
points.title: Third party cookies are employed, but with opt out instructions

points.case_title: You can opt out of targeted advertising
points.quote_text:
Interest-based advertising tools

Advertising companies may participate in self-regulatory programs which allow you to opt out of any interest-based ads involving them. For more information on this, you can visit the following sites: Digital Advertising Alliance; Interactive Digital Advertising Alliance; Appchoices (apps only).
points.title: You can opt out of targeted advertising

points.case_title: Information is gathered about you through third parties
points.quote_text: We also collect data from third parties, like when you access the service through an account you have on another platform (e.g., Facebook, Google or Apple) or when you upload information from your account on another platform to complete your profile.
points.title: Information is gathered about you through third parties

points.case_title: Many different types of personal data are collected
points.quote_text: | Account Data | When you create an account, you give us basic information for your account to be set up such as your phone number, email address, and date of birth. | | Profile Data | When you complete your profile, you share additional details about you, such as your gender, interests, preferences, approximate location, etc. Some of this data may be considered sensitive or special in certain countries, such as details about sexual orientation, sexual life, health, or political beliefs. If you choose to provide this data, you consent to us using it as laid out in this Privacy Policy. | | Content | When you use our service, you  share photos, videos, audio, text and other types of content, such as your search queries or chats with other members. | | Purchase Data |
points.title: Many different types of personal data are collected

points.case_title: Your personal data may be used for marketing purposes
points.quote_text: We sometimes run (i) surveys, focus groups, or market studies for research purposes and (ii) promotions, events or contests for marketing purposes.
points.title: Your personal data may be used for marketing purposes

points.case_title: Your personal information may be collected, regardless of whether you interacted directly with the service or not
points.quote_text: When you choose to share with us information about other people (for example, if you use the contact details of someone you know for a given feature or if you submit a query or report involving a member), we process this data on your behalf to complete your request. For more information on the Friends in Common feature see here, and you can learn more about how Tinder processes the information of non-members here.
points.title: They store data on you even if you did not interact with the service

points.case_title: Your profile is combined across various products
points.quote_text: If you were banned from another Match Group service, your data can be shared with us to allow us to take necessary actions, including closing your account or preventing you from creating an account on our service.
points.title: Your profile is combined across various products

points.case_title: Referring and/or exit pages are tracked
points.quote_text: Using the service generates data about your activity, including how you use it (e.g., when you logged in, features you’ve been using, actions taken, information shown to you, referring webpages
points.title: This service tracks which web page referred you to it

points.case_title: You may be tracked on other websites
points.quote_text: We also receive data related to interactions you had with our ads on third party websites or apps, if applicable.
points.title: This service tracks you on other websites

points.case_title: Your biometric data is collected
points.quote_text: | Face Data | You may choose to participate in certain of our features like Photo Verification, Photo Check, or ID + Photo Verification, that involve the collection of face geometry data, which may be considered biometric data in some jurisdictions.
points.title: Your biometric data is collected

points.case_title: Information is provided about how your personal data is used
points.quote_text: 4. Why and How We Use Your Data
points.title: Information is provided about how your personal data is used

points.case_title: Your personal data is used to employ targeted third-party advertising
points.quote_text: And yes, we process your data to show relevant ads – you can control this in your settings.
points.title: Your personal data is used to employ targeted third-party advertising

points.case_title: Your personal data is used for automated decision-making, profiling or AI training
points.quote_text: Developing and improving new features and services, including through machine learning and other technologies, and testing them out
points.title: Your personal data is used for automated decision-making, profiling or AI training

points.case_title: Your IP address is collected, which can be used to view your approximate location
points.quote_text: Using the service involves the collection of data from and about the device(s) you use to access our service, including hardware and software information such as IP address
points.title: Your IP address is collected, which can be used to view your approximate location

points.case_title: App required for this service requires broad device permissions
points.quote_text: Using the service involves the collection of data from and about the device(s) you use to access our service, including hardware and software information such as IP address, device ID device type, operating systems and configurations, network information, device movement and sensor data, as well as app settings and characteristics, app crashes, advertising IDs and identifiers associated with cookies or other technologies that can uniquely identify a device or browser.
points.title: App required for this service requires broad device permissions

points.case_title: Location data may be collected, used and/or shared
points.quote_text: | Geolocation Data |
points.title: This service may collect, use, and share location data

points.case_title: This service receives your precise location through GPS coordinates
points.quote_text: | Geolocation Data | If you give us permission, we can collect your geolocation (latitude and longitude) from your device. If you decline permission, certain features that rely on precise geolocation will not be available to you.
points.title: This service receives your precise location through GPS coordinates

points.case_title: Banned users are prohibited from creating a new account
points.quote_text: Preventing recurrences, notably by preventing individuals who violate our Terms from creating a new account
points.title: Users who have been permanently banned from this service are not allowed to re-register under a new account

points.case_title: Your personal data may be disclosed to comply with government requests without notice to you
points.quote_text: Compliance with legal obligations applying to us such as responding to law enforcement requests for information
points.title: Your personal data may be disclosed to comply with government requests without notice to you

points.case_title: This service gives your personal data to third parties involved in its operation
points.quote_text: We also share data with service providers and partners who assist us in operating the service, with other Match Group companies for the reasons laid out below and, in some cases, for legal and related reasons.
points.title: This service gives your personal data to third parties involved in its operation

points.case_title: This service shares your personal data with third parties that are not essential to its operation
points.quote_text: Where permitted by applicable law, we may also share data with partners (such as companies facing similar threats), and they may share data with us, when necessary to promote the safety, security, and integrity of our service, our Members, our employees, and others.
points.title: This service shares your personal data with third parties that are not essential to its operation

points.case_title: Sensitive data is collected and shared to target advertising
points.quote_text: To help improve the relevance of these ads, we provide certain info about you to third parties, including advertising partners, or allow them to collect such data from our services (such as via cookies, SDKs, or similar technologies).
points.title: Sensitive data is collected and shared to target advertising

points.case_title: Your personal data may be sold or otherwise transferred as part of a bankruptcy proceeding or other type of financial transaction
points.quote_text: We may transfer your data if we are involved, whether in whole or in part, in a merger, sale, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution, bankruptcy or other change of ownership or control.
points.title: Your personal data may be sold or otherwise transferred as part of a bankruptcy proceeding or other type of financial transaction

points.case_title: Your data may be processed and stored anywhere in the world
points.quote_text: Because we operate a global service, the sharing of your data laid out in Section 5 involves cross-border data transfers to our Affiliates and service providers (other third parties) in third countries that have different privacy laws.
points.title: Your data may be processed and stored anywhere in the world

points.case_title: You can retrieve an archive of your data
points.quote_text: You can access and review some data directly by logging into your account. You can also retrieve a copy of your data by following the process explained here.
points.title: You can retrieve an archive of your data

points.case_title: You can request access, correction and/or deletion of your data
points.quote_text:
| Rectification or Correction 

Right to amend or update your personal data where it’s inaccurate or incomplete | You can update your data directly within the service by simply updating your profile. If you wish to rectify other data, please contact us here. | | Deletion or Erasure

Right to delete personal data | You can delete some of the data you provided us directly within the service.
points.title: You can request access, correction and/or deletion of your data

points.case_title: You can limit how your information is used by third parties and the service
points.quote_text: You can directly opt-out from certain of your personal data processing in your account settings. Otherwise you can contact us here should you wish to object to or restrict a data processing we’ve listed throughout this Privacy Policy.
points.title: You can limit how your information is used by third-parties and the service

points.case_title: Your personal data may be sold unless you opt out
points.quote_text: If we “sell” or “share” your data or use it for “targeted advertising,” we will provide an opt out in the “Your Privacy Choices” link in the footer of our website and in the Settings menu of the app. Adjust the “Sale or Sharing of Personal Information” toggle accordingly to opt out.
points.title: Your Personal data may be sold unless you opt out

points.case_title: You are tracked via web beacons, tracking pixels, browser fingerprinting, and/or device fingerprinting
points.quote_text: Other technologies such as web beacons (also called pixel, tags or clear gifs), tracking URLs or software development kits (SDKs) are used for similar purposes as cookies.
points.title: You are tracked via web beacons, tracking pixels, browser fingerprinting, and/or device fingerprinting

points.case_title: Third-party cookies are employed, but with opt out instructions
points.quote_text: You can opt out of Google Analytics by downloading the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on and opt-out of Google’s ad personalization.
points.title: Third party cookies are employed, but with opt out instructions

points.case_title: A free help desk is provided
points.quote_text: If you have questions about this Cookie Policy, you can contact us online to submit a help request:
points.title: A free help desk is provided

points.case_title: You are being tracked via social media cookies/pixels
points.quote_text: | Social Media Data | You decide to share data with us through your accounts on other platforms (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, Spotify, Apple, LinkedIn), for instance if you decide to create and log into your account via these platforms or if you decide to upload data such as photos or playlists onto our service from these platforms.
points.title: You are being tracked via social media cookies/pixels
